This page documents my use of generative AI for EPPS 6356 Assignment 9
([static maps](maps.qmd)).

## Tool Information

| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| **Tool** | Claude (Anthropic), used in the Claude app, linked to my course folder and my website folder |
| **Date** | November 16, 2026 |
| **My files** | `scripts/tea/01_download_tea.R`, `02_clean_tea.R`, `03_boundaries.R`, `data/tea/README.md`, `PLAN.md`, `maps.qmd` |

## What Claude Did

- Read the Assignment 9 and Class 10 handouts and my Assignment 8 dashboard, and
  pointed out that our PLAN said Shinylive, which Assignment 9 does not accept for a
  Quarto dashboard, so the deployment plan changed to Posit Connect Cloud.
- Found the TEA download page for district discipline data and checked its file format
  in the browser, then wrote the R script that downloads the 120 files (6 school years x
  20 regions) and the script that cleans them and computes the risk ratios.
- Found a boundary file (NCES EDGE 2023-24) that already contains the TEA district number,
  so no crosswalk is needed, and wrote the script that downloads it.
- Tested the cleaning script on sample files, checked the join (which districts do not
  match and why), and computed the numbers used in the map titles.
- Wrote the Assignment 9 section of `PLAN.md` and the code and text of `maps.qmd`.

## Prompts

The conversation was in Traditional Chinese. These are the prompts that shaped the
assignment, with English translations.

1. > 這禮拜要完成這個可以帶我做嗎 好像要和隊友報告什麼的
   >
   > *(I need to finish this this week. Can you guide me? I think I also need to report something to my teammates.)*

2. > 隊友叫我先整理這些東西TEA，這可以說是我這禮拜的作業
   >
   > *(My teammates asked me to prepare the TEA data first; you could say that is my homework this week.)*

3. > 從下載 TEA 資料開始
   >
   > *(Start with downloading the TEA data.)*

## My Decisions

- I chose to use our team's TEA data instead of the HPI data, so that the same work
  serves both Assignment 9 and my task for the team.
- I ran the download and cleaning scripts on my own computer and checked the results
  before sharing them with my teammates.
- Two choices are still open for the team: whether the risk ratio counts students or
  actions, and whether we need discretionary actions only (see `data/tea/README.md`).
